torque.value: Lower mounting brackets thread-forming screws 35 in-lb; breaker captive terminal screws into threaded strap holes 35 in-lb; upper bracket #8-32 screws 18 in-lb (after sliding bracket to engage the toothed section with the steel flange under the breaker); strap-to-vertical-bus 65 in-lb

id_features.value: Kit includes a B-phase isolator whose flaps fold up into the grooves of the TEY housing between phases; straps installed starting with the pole farthest from the 2.75 in dimension, carriage bolt head opposite the 2.75 in side

location.value: Spectra APNB bolt-on interior: straps bolt to the vertical bus on the side where nearest vertical bus face to inner face of bus-support rail = 2.75 in; breaker mounting brackets fasten to the panel side rails
